from pathlib import Path
program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # A diagonal color run extends outward from both ends until it meets
    # another non-background cell or the grid edge.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                # Extend backward from this run's first cell.
                rr, cc = r - dr, c - dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr, cc = rr - dr, cc - dc
                # Extend forward from the pair and any contiguous same-color run.
                rr, cc = nr, nc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                    out[rr][cc] = color
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
    return out
'''
path=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e0437033.py')
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(program)
ns={}; exec(program,ns)
